name: @fastvideo/dreamverse-blender
description: Installable DreamVerse Blender bundle: connect your own Blender to the harness with the DreamVerse add-on, watch its viewport live in a Blender tab, and let the agent read the scene, run Python, look at the viewport and render stills and animations into the project; it adds @fastvideo/dreamverse-blender-bridge, @fastvideo/dreamverse-ui-blender, and @fastvideo/dreamverse-workflow-blender to a DreamVerse profile.
